# EvAccordion

> A collapsible section: a header button with a title and optional subtext that shows or hides its panel.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:accordion` |
| Layer | Molecule (`src/molecules`) |
| Import | `import { EvAccordion } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvAccordion>` or `<ev-accordion>` |
| Source | `src/molecules/accordion/EvAccordion.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the root `<div class="ev-accordion">` |

## Example

```vue
<EvAccordion
  title="Syarat dan ketentuan"
  subtext="Berlaku sejak 1 Jan 2026"
>
  Isi panel muncul ketika accordion dibuka.
</EvAccordion>
```

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Accordion**, frame `4105:63588` (Accordion). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Group related content into collapsible sections — FAQs, settings, long forms — so users scan headings first and expand only what's relevant.

### When not to use

- Don't hide critical content users always need — show it inline. Avoid deeply nesting accordions inside one another.

### Do

- Keep titles short and descriptive. Let panel content reflow naturally. Use subtext to add brief secondary context.

### Don't

- Don't place primary actions only inside collapsed panels. Don't disable an accordion without a clear reason.

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvAccordion`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the root `<div class="ev-accordion">`.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:accordion` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
